verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents issuing API keys, including a flow where an agent creates its own account and API key from the terminal. The self-hosted server adds per-user API keys and a request audit log, which gives some per-identity separation. Entity-scoped memory partitions data by user, agent, or app, but that is data organization, not credential scoping. Missing for 10: documented permission scopes or read-only/restricted keys, per-agent least-privilege key issuance on Platform, key expiry/rotation controls, and independent corroboration.
